action.public_message: Hey Beta, let’s both get a monopoly! I’ll give you Atlantic Avenue + $60 for your New York Avenue. Then we each have a full color set.
action.private_thought: Beta holds New York (orange) while I have the other two orange properties. Trading Atlantic for New York plus $60 gives me the orange monopoly and gives Beta the yellow monopoly. This mutually beneficial trade should improve both our positions and increase my chance to build houses quickly.
